intro: Equatorial Guinea is made up of a mainland region and several islands.

chapters.title: Mainland and islands
text: Bioko is volcanic, with Pico Basilé, the highest point. Río Muni on the mainland is covered by rainforest. Annobón lies far to the south-west.

chapters.title: Climate
text: The climate is hot and very wet.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Equatorial Guinea's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
